name: tsa_getRedemptionSummary
description: Returns redeemed-order counts grouped by date, restaurant and meal, newest date first, optionally for one restaurant. NULL @restaurantId = all restaurants (admin view). Called by the TSA Eats Next.js app (tsa-eats/lib/api.ts) through api/Endpoints/TsaApi.cs, which maps queryType 'getRedemptionSummary' to [TSA].[tsa_getRedemptionSummary]. There is no Harrier Central auth: POST requires the shared X-Api-Key (TsaApiKey); GET requires nothing, and the shim does not restrict which procedure a GET may name. The shim turns any one-row rowset with Success = 0 into HTTP 400 {success:false, errorMessage}, and an empty first rowset into HTTP 404.

parameters.name: restaurantId
parameters.description: Optional restaurant filter. Default NULL = all restaurants.

rowsets.name: RedemptionCounts
rowsets.description: Zero or more rows ordered by date DESC, restaurantName, count DESC.

codeSmells.issue: SP body not wrapped in TRY/CATCH
codeSmells.detail: Read procedure with no TRY/CATCH: any runtime error (timeout, deadlock) becomes an unlogged raw 500 from the shim.
Line 26 groups by r.name and mi.name; two restaurants or dishes with the same name merge into one row.
